name: Leaving the Glowsheep
source:
A visual novel about someone called Al who should probably escape from a dragon tamer but isn't sure what will happen if they do. The dragon tamer is a necromancer that seems to turn people into ghosts, although the story is sorta vague about what he gets the ghosts to do. There's also another cahracter that tries to help the dragon tamer and some that try to help Al.

[From [url=https://sealiteral.itch.io/leaving-the-glowsheep]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
這是一部視覺小說，講述名叫Al的人。Al本該逃離一名馴龍者，卻不確定逃走後會發生什麼。馴龍者是個亡靈法師，似乎會把人變成幽靈；至於他究竟讓幽靈做什麼，故事說得有些含糊。此外，還有一個角色試圖幫助馴龍者，也有一些人想幫助Al。

[來源：[url=https://sealiteral.itch.io/leaving-the-glowsheep]Itch.io[/url]]
